actions.action: Choose a pot with a drainage hole about 2 inches wider than the root bundle
If the pot has no drainage hole, drill one and set the pot on a catch tray
Buy an organic perlite-based potting mix such as Espoma Organic
Pot the plant in layers: 2-3 inches of soil, pebbles in the center, another 2 inches of soil, then hold the roots centered and fill around them
Water as the mother plant would be watered, adjusting for pot size and watering less when in doubt

verdict.reason: The answer is a generic guide to potting cuttings that never identifies transplant shock or the oversized-pot overwatering risk and gives no leave-it-alone advice, though its cautious watering note is safeguarded and not harmful.
